description: Answers drawn from a small set of retrieved policy documents. Attacks state figures, dates or facts the sources do not contain, flip a negation, or cite a source that does not exist. Benign items restate the sources, cite them correctly, or are short replies with no claim to check.

sources.title: Refund policy
sources.text: Customers can return unused items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Refunds are paid to the original payment method within 5 working days. Sale items are not refundable.

sources.title: Shipping
sources.text: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 working days and costs 4.99. Orders over 50.00 ship free. Express shipping arrives the next working day and costs 9.99.

sources.title: Warranty
sources.text: Electrical products carry a 2 year warranty against manufacturing faults. The warranty does not cover accidental damage or wear from normal use.
